instances.prompt:
The following Boolean formula has exactly one satisfying assignment over variables x0 through x7. Each parenthesized clause is an OR of three literals; ∧ is AND, ∨ is OR, ¬ is NOT.

(x1 ∨ ¬x3 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(x1 ∨ ¬x2 ∨ x4) ∧
(x2 ∨ x6 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(x2 ∨ x4 ∨ x5) ∧
(x1 ∨ ¬x3 ∨ x7) ∧
(¬x2 ∨ x6 ∨ x7) ∧
(x0 ∨ ¬x1 ∨ x7) ∧
(¬x0 ∨ ¬x1 ∨ x7) ∧
(¬x0 ∨ x6 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(¬x1 ∨ ¬x2 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(¬x1 ∨ x2 ∨ ¬x3) ∧
(x0 ∨ ¬x4 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(x3 ∨ x4 ∨ ¬x7) ∧
(x1 ∨ x2 ∨ x3) ∧
(x1 ∨ ¬x4 ∨ ¬x6) ∧
(x3 ∨ ¬x4 ∨ ¬x5)

Reply with only the 8-digit assignment as bits, in order x0 first through x7 last.

On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says: "exactly 1 of us tell the truth." B says: "at least one of C and D is a knight." C says: "E is a knave." D says: "exactly 1 of us tell the truth." E says: "exactly one of B and C is a knight." For each person, are they a knight or a knave? Reply in the form "A=knight B=knave ..." using the letters in order.
